caption: A hairdryer resting on a counter with ribbons tied to its nozzle is switched on, and the ribbons stream out in the airflow.

sa.check: A hairdryer rests on a counter with ribbons tied to its nozzle.
The ribbons stream out in the airflow.
The ribbons hang slack before the switch.
The order is slack, switch, streaming.

pc.expect: The ribbons lift and stream away from the nozzle at the moment the switch is moved, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is moved and the ribbons hang slack to the end of the clip; or the ribbons stream before the switch is touched; or the ribbons stream while the dryer lies untouched; or the ribbons blow toward the nozzle.

pc.expect: While the dryer runs the ribbons keep streaming and fluttering in the same direction; they drop slack only if the dryer is switched off.
pc.fail: The ribbons fall slack while the dryer is still on; or stream and drop repeatedly with the switch untouched; or stiffen into a fixed shape; or the switch moves back by itself.

pc.expect: The ribbons stream away from the nozzle along the direction it points, rippling along their length.
pc.fail: The ribbons stream sideways or backward from the nozzle; or stand straight up from a nozzle pointing along the counter; or each ribbon streams in a different direction.

pc.expect: The dryer stays where it rests as it runs, apart from a small shift; other items on the counter stay put unless in the airflow.
pc.fail: The dryer slides or spins across the counter; or lifts into the air; or items behind the dryer blow away; or light items in the airflow stay perfectly still.

pc.expect: One dryer with its ribbons tied on; the ribbons stay attached to the nozzle; the dryer keeps its shape.
pc.fail: Ribbons detach and fly off; or ribbons appear or vanish; or a second dryer appears; or the dryer changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dryer's colour, the ribbons' colours and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The dryer changes colour; or a ribbon changes colour or length; or the counter's contents rearrange.
